oracle.sql: SELECT c.data->>'customer_name' || ' | last service ' || max(v.dt)::text AS ref FROM entities c JOIN (SELECT l.entity_id, (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) AS dt FROM document_entity_links l JOIN documents d ON d.id = l.document_id JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = d.id AND y.field_key = 'service_date' WHERE lower(replace(d.document_type, '_', '-')) = ANY($2::text[])) v ON v.entity_id = c.id AND v.dt <= $1::date WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.data HAVING max(v.dt) < $1::date - 365 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 15

questions.text: Give me invoiced revenue month by month for this year

oracle.sql: SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') || ': ' || sum_t AS ref FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date)) AS m, sum(COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'total' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (f.corrections->>'total')::numeric END, f.total)) AS sum_t FROM document_financials f WHERE f.doc_kind = 'invoice' AND f.direction = 'receivable' AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) >= date_trunc('year', $1::date)::date AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) < (date_trunc('year', $1::date) + interval '1 year')::date GROUP BY 1) z ORDER BY 1

requires.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM document_financials f WHERE f.doc_kind = 'invoice' AND f.direction = 'receivable'

oracle.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT y.document_id || (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END)::text) FROM extractions y WHERE y.field_key = 'service_date' AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) >= (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '1 month')::date AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) < date_trunc('month', $1::date)::date) > (SELECT count(DISTINCT y.document_id || (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END)::text) FROM extractions y WHERE y.field_key = 'service_date' AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) >= (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '2 months')::date AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) < (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '1 month')::date) AS v

questions.text: Did we invoice more last month than the month before?

oracle.sql: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'total' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (f.corrections->>'total')::numeric END, f.total)), 0) FROM document_financials f WHERE f.doc_kind = 'invoice' AND f.direction = 'receivable' AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) >= (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '1 month')::date AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) < date_trunc('month', $1::date)::date) > (SELECT coalesce(sum(COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'total' ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (f.corrections->>'total')::numeric END, f.total)), 0) FROM document_financials f WHERE f.doc_kind = 'invoice' AND f.direction = 'receivable' AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) >= (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '2 months')::date AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN f.corrections->>'invoice_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN (f.corrections->>'invoice_date')::date END, f.invoice_date) < (date_trunc('month', $1::date) - interval '1 month')::date) AS v

questions.text: Which customer has the most units?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.data->>'customer_name' AS k, count(*) AS n FROM entities c JOIN entities e ON e.customer_id = c.id AND e.entity_type = 'equipment' AND e.merged_into IS NULL WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.data) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Which customer has the most documents on file?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.data->>'customer_name' AS k, count(DISTINCT l.document_id) AS n FROM entities c JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.entity_id = c.id WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.data) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Which customer have we been out to the most times?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.data->>'customer_name' AS k, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END)) AS n FROM entities c JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.entity_id = c.id JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = l.document_id AND y.field_key = 'service_date' JOIN documents d ON d.id = y.document_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND lower(replace(d.document_type, '_', '-')) = ANY($1::text[]) AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) <= $2::date GROUP BY c.id, c.data) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Which city has the most customers?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT (SELECT z.s FROM (SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.seg, '(^|[[:space:],])[A-Za-z]{2}[[:space:]]*[0-9]{5}([[:space:]-]*[0-9]{4})?[[:space:]]*$', ''), '(^|[[:space:],])[A-Z]{2}[[:space:]]*$', '')) AS s, t.ord FROM unnest(string_to_array((c.data->>'service_address'), ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(seg, ord) WHERE t.ord > 1) z WHERE z.s <> '' AND z.s !~ '[0-9]' AND z.s !~* '^(suite|ste|unit|apt|apartment|bldg|building|floor|fl|room|rm|lot|space|spc)([[:space:].]|$)' ORDER BY z.ord DESC LIMIT 1) AS k, count(*) AS n FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Which zip code has the most customers?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT substring((c.data->>'service_address') from '([0-9]{5})([[:space:]-]*[0-9]{4})?[[:space:]]*$') AS k, count(*) AS n FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Which state do most of our customers live in?

oracle.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(upper(substring((c.data->>'service_address') from '(?:^|[^A-Za-z])([A-Za-z]{2})[[:space:]]*[0-9]{5}([[:space:]-]*[0-9]{4})?[[:space:]]*$')), upper(substring((c.data->>'service_address') from ',[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z]{2})[[:space:]]*$')), CASE WHEN (c.data->>'service_address') ~* '\marizona\M' THEN 'AZ' END) AS k, count(*) AS n FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT k AS v FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL AND n = (SELECT max(n) FROM g WHERE k IS NOT NULL)

questions.text: Of our Trane customers, how many are in Mesa?

oracle.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND lower((SELECT z.s FROM (SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t.seg, '(^|[[:space:],])[A-Za-z]{2}[[:space:]]*[0-9]{5}([[:space:]-]*[0-9]{4})?[[:space:]]*$', ''), '(^|[[:space:],])[A-Z]{2}[[:space:]]*$', '')) AS s, t.ord FROM unnest(string_to_array((c.data->>'service_address'), ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(seg, ord) WHERE t.ord > 1) z WHERE z.s <> '' AND z.s !~ '[0-9]' AND z.s !~* '^(suite|ste|unit|apt|apartment|bldg|building|floor|fl|room|rm|lot|space|spc)([[:space:].]|$)' ORDER BY z.ord DESC LIMIT 1)) = lower($1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.entity_type = 'equipment' AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.customer_id = c.id AND lower(e.data->>'manufacturer') = lower($2))

oracle.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.data->>'customer_name' AS item FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.entity_type = 'equipment' AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.customer_id = c.id AND (CASE WHEN e.data->>'installation_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(e.data->>'installation_date', 1, 10)::date END) IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT c.id AS cust_id, d.id AS doc_id, (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) AS dt, (SELECT t.value FROM extractions t WHERE t.document_id = d.id AND t.field_key = 'technician' LIMIT 1) AS tech FROM document_entity_links l JOIN documents d ON d.id = l.document_id LEFT JOIN entities le ON le.id = l.entity_id AND le.entity_type = 'equipment' JOIN entities c ON (c.id = l.entity_id OR c.id = le.customer_id) AND c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = d.id AND y.field_key = 'service_date' WHERE lower(replace(d.document_type, '_', '-')) = ANY($1::text[]) AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) <= $2::date) vv WHERE vv.cust_id = c.id AND vv.dt > (CASE WHEN e.data->>'installation_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(e.data->>'installation_date', 1, 10)::date END) AND vv.dt <= (CASE WHEN e.data->>'installation_date' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(e.data->>'installation_date', 1, 10)::date END) + 30) ) ORDER BY 1

oracle.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT c.id AS cust_id, d.id AS doc_id, (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) AS dt, (SELECT t.value FROM extractions t WHERE t.document_id = d.id AND t.field_key = 'technician' LIMIT 1) AS tech FROM document_entity_links l JOIN documents d ON d.id = l.document_id LEFT JOIN entities le ON le.id = l.entity_id AND le.entity_type = 'equipment' JOIN entities c ON (c.id = l.entity_id OR c.id = le.customer_id) AND c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = d.id AND y.field_key = 'service_date' WHERE lower(replace(d.document_type, '_', '-')) = ANY($1::text[]) AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) <= $2::date) SELECT DISTINCT c.data->>'customer_name' AS item FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v a JOIN v b ON b.cust_id = a.cust_id AND b.doc_id <> a.doc_id AND b.dt > a.dt AND b.dt <= a.dt + 14 WHERE a.cust_id = c.id) ORDER BY 1

oracle.sql: SELECT name AS item FROM (SELECT c.data->>'customer_name' AS name, sum(f.total) FILTER (WHERE f.doc_kind = 'invoice') AS inv_total, sum(f.total) FILTER (WHERE f.doc_kind = 'estimate') AS quote_total FROM document_financials f JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.document_id = f.document_id LEFT JOIN entities le ON le.id = l.entity_id AND le.entity_type = 'equipment' JOIN entities c ON (c.id = l.entity_id OR c.id = le.customer_id) AND c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL WHERE f.doc_kind IN ('invoice', 'estimate') AND f.direction = 'receivable' GROUP BY c.id, c.data) g WHERE inv_total IS NOT NULL AND quote_total IS NOT NULL AND abs(inv_total - quote_total) > 1 ORDER BY 1

oracle.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END)::text || ' | ' || lower(replace(d.document_type, '_', '-')) || ' | ' || left(regexp_replace(coalesce((SELECT string_agg(p.text, ' ') FROM document_pages p WHERE p.document_id = d.id), ''), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS ref FROM extractions y JOIN documents d ON d.id = y.document_id WHERE y.field_key = 'service_date' AND y.document_id IN (SELECT l.document_id FROM document_entity_links l WHERE l.entity_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1) UNION SELECT l.document_id FROM document_entity_links l JOIN entities e ON e.id = l.entity_id WHERE e.entity_type = 'equipment' AND e.customer_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1)) AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) >= date_trunc('year', $2::date)::date AND (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) < (date_trunc('year', $2::date) + interval '1 year')::date ORDER BY (CASE WHEN y.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN substr(y.value, 1, 10)::date END) ASC LIMIT 10

oracle.sql: SELECT field || ': record says ' || coalesce(onfile, '(nothing on file)') || ' -- document ' || docname || ' (' || coalesce(docdate::text, 'undated') || ') says ' || docval AS ref FROM ( SELECT 'phone' AS field, c.data->>'phone' AS onfile, y.value AS docval, d.original_filename AS docname, d.created_at::date AS docdate FROM entities c JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.entity_id = c.id JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = l.document_id AND y.field_key = 'phone' JOIN documents d ON d.id = y.document_id WHERE c.id IN (SELECT c.id FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1) AND coalesce(y.value, '') <> '' AND regexp_replace(y.value, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> regexp_replace(coalesce(c.data->>'phone', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') UNION ALL SELECT 'email', c.data->>'email', y.value, d.original_filename, d.created_at::date FROM entities c JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.entity_id = c.id JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = l.document_id AND y.field_key = 'email' JOIN documents d ON d.id = y.document_id WHERE c.id IN (SELECT c.id FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1) AND coalesce(y.value, '') <> '' AND lower(btrim(y.value)) <> lower(btrim(coalesce(c.data->>'email', ''))) UNION ALL SELECT 'address', c.data->>'service_address', y.value, d.original_filename, d.created_at::date FROM entities c JOIN document_entity_links l ON l.entity_id = c.id JOIN extractions y ON y.document_id = l.document_id AND y.field_key = 'service_address' JOIN documents d ON d.id = y.document_id WHERE c.id IN (SELECT c.id FROM entities c WHERE c.entity_type = 'customer' AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1) AND coalesce(y.value, '') <> '' AND lower(btrim(y.value)) <> lower(btrim(coalesce(c.data->>'service_address', ''))) ) z ORDER BY docdate DESC LIMIT 6
